caption: The drawing depicts a single object that resembles a dagger or short sword positioned vertically on a plain, light-colored background. The handle of the object is carved and shaped to look like the head of a bird, with a prominent beak and detailed feathers rendered in shades of yellow, brown, and green. The handle transitions into a section tightly wrapped in a beige-colored material adorned with parallel and diagonal lines. Below the handle, there is a thin horizontal band, darker brown in color, separating the handle from the blade. The blade itself is long, narrow, and metallic gray, with a central groove running along most of its length, and it ends in a rounded point. The composition is simple and centered, with the object taking up most of the vertical space, and the artist's signature appears in the lower right corner.
title: Dagger
